source.title: Feralas Mission XVII: Rescue Nerene Brooksinger
source.description: While these demons distract us here, the Emerald Dream is being corrupted into nightmare. Quick, travel through the Emerald Dream Portal in Dream Bough, and journey to the Nightmare Incursion at the Twin Colossals. Find the sleeping Druid of the Claw Nerene Brooksinger there and escort her to safety. Then return to me.
source.objective: Rescue Nerene Brooksinger from the Feralas Nightmare Incursion at the campfire at the Twin Colossals and return to Field Captain Arunnel.
source.completion: Well done! Your services shall be well rewarded. Perhaps another mission?
